simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּנָה (H1129) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 377 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בָּנָה (bânâh) means to build (literally and figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 5 36.

definitions.usage: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), × surely.
